item.title: About Our Small Job Handyman Services | Local & Reliable
item.description:
About Radiant Home Solutions

Your local small job specialists - where no repair is too small and every customer matters.

Our Story

Radiant Home Solutions was founded on a simple principle: no job is too small for professional attention. We noticed that many homeowners struggled to find reliable help for small repairs and minor improvements - the kind of tasks that other contractors consider “not worth their time.”

We built our business specifically to fill this gap. Whether you need a single picture hung or want to tackle your entire honey-do list, we bring the same professional approach and quality craftsmanship to every job, regardless of size.

item.title: Small Handyman Jobs | Quick Home Repairs | Same Day Service
item.description:
Small Handyman Jobs - Our Specialty

No job too small! We specialize in the quick fixes and small improvements that other contractors won’t touch.

What Makes a “Small Job”?

Small jobs are typically tasks that can be completed in 4 hours or less and don’t require permits or major material purchases. These are the items on your honey-do list that you keep putting off!

Examples of Small Jobs We Love:

  • Hanging pictures and mirrors
  • Fixing squeaky doors
  • Replacing light fixtures
  • Installing shelves
  • Patching small holes in walls
  • Adjusting cabinet doors
  • Replacing faucets
  • Installing grab bars
  • Mounting TVs
  • Assembling furniture

Our Small Job Promise

Same-Day Service

Call before noon, and we’ll often complete your small job the same day. Perfect for last-minute preparations or urgent fixes.
